metadata.dcterms:title: 1-LOOP EQUALS TORSION FOR TWO-BRIDGE KNOTS
metadata.dcterms:creator: GAROUFALIDIS, STAVROS
YOON, SEOKBEOM
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Motivated by the conjectured asymptotics of the Kashaev invariant, Dimofte and the first author introduced a power series associated to a suitable ideal triangulation of a cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold, proved that its constant (1-loop) term is a topological invariant and conjectured that it equals to the adjoint Reidemeister torsion. We prove this conjecture for hyperbolic 2-bridge knots by combining the work of Ohtsuki–Takata with an explicit computation.
